title: MZ VisuStella MZ Main Menu Core - Portraits

posts.author: Blindheit
posts.body:
Good day,
sorry total Noob Question, I am pretty new to RPG Maker and have not experience with Java Script. I installed The Visu Stella Core Plugins and I am trying right now to make the main Menu look like in one of their pictures:
So I want big images of the characters in the background (like in the image above) instead of the small standard portraits. But sadly I simply can not figure out how to do so. As I understand I need to change some settings in the main menu plugin and make a Plugin Command to change the actors main menu image. But I must be doing something wrong there, or I am missing something, because until now, there has been no success.
If anyone could give me a step by step tutorial how to achieve this, I would highly appreciate it. Thanks

posts.author: rpgLord69
posts.body:
Put in actor notes notetags <Menu Portrait: filename> (no file extension)
The picture file needs to be in your img/pictures/ folder
Then in the plugin settings change the 'Main Menu List Style' setting to 'Portrait Style'

posts.author: Blindheit
posts.body: Thank you so much, the actor notetags were missing. Once they were in there it worked.
